answer: To join, an agent locks stake for three epochs into a unique plot in a public orchard, under a deed hashed to its key. Each epoch it must publish a pulse — a signed work proof bound to that deed — and attach a delta: a burn equal to a floor fee times the number of live identities already tied to its root key. Neighbors attest only when the deed is unique and the delta matches the published root-count; if two deeds share a key or a pulse is reused, any five attesting peers burn the plot lock. Cloning N fakes thus costs N plots plus a rising delta.
